title: Herding or Racing? Decomposing Cross-Account Order-Flow Persistence in On-Chain Markets
abstract: arXiv:2611.02616v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Most of the autocorrelation in trade signs on decentralized exchanges comes from pairs of trades sent by different wallets. For Uniswap v3, this has been read as herding dominating order splitting -- the reverse of what equity markets show. We show that this herding share mixes two quantities: the probability $p$ that consecutive orders come from the same account, which is small when thousands of wallets are trading, and the ratio $\kappa$ of cross-account to same-account sign correlation. For any $p$, $\kappa$ equals one under the public-signal benchmark of T\'oth et al. and zero under independent order splitting. On Uniswap v3 USDC-WETH (one week each in 2023 and 2024), the herding share is 0.65-0.86, but $\kappa$ is only 0.05-0.10. translated_title: 羊群还是竞速？分解链上市场中跨账户订单流持续性
translated_abstract: 去中心化交易所交易符号中的大部分自相关性来自由不同钱包发送的交易对。对于 Uniswap v3，这被解读为羊群行为主导订单拆分——与股票市场的情况相反。我们证明这一“羊群占比”实际上混合了两个量：连续订单来自同一账户的概率 p（当数千个钱包参与交易时该概率很小），以及跨账户与同账户符号相关性之比 κ。对于任意 p，在 Tóth 等人的公开信号基准下 κ 等于 1，而在独立订单拆分下 κ 等于 0。在 Uniswap v3 USDC-WETH 交易对上（2023 年和 2024 年各取一周数据），羊群占比为 0.65–0.86，但 κ 仅为 0.05–0.10。在一个完全链上的 EVM 限价订单簿上，羊群占比相近（0.61–0.87），但 κ 高达 0.72–0.76；在金额超过 10 万美元的 Uniswap 大额交易中，κ 为 0.34–0.52。在 κ 较高的地方，跨账……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出将链上订单流持续性分解为同账户订单概率 p 与跨账户/同账户符号相关性之比 κ 两个指标，发现 Uniswap v3 上看似的“羊群效应”主要源于订单拆分（κ 仅 0.05–0.10），而真正由跨账户模仿驱动的持续性主导了链上限价订单簿（κ 约 0.72–0.76）和大额交易。
en_tdlr: The paper decomposes on-chain order-flow persistence into the same-account clustering probability p and the cross-account to same-account sign correlation ratio κ, showing that the apparent herding on Uniswap v3 is mostly order splitting (κ ≈ 0.05–0.10), while cross-account imitation dominates in a fully on-chain EVM limit order book (κ ≈ 0.72–0.76) and in large trades.
